description: Where are Hyperliquid's most profitable accounts positioned? Reads the open positions of the top 20 accounts by day, week, month or all-time P&L. For a coin: long vs short notional and account counts, size-weighted average entry per side, share of open interest, the biggest holders, and where their liquidation prices cluster above and below mark. Without a coin: their largest net exposures. Plus 24 h changes (flips, opens, closes) from our snapshots. Not advice. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.
